committee: *Presentation - Certificate No. 403-38 (COR) - Senator William A. Parkinson
title: Håfa Adai! Please join us for the presentation of Certificate No. 403-38 (COR) - William A. Parkinson. Relative to recognizing: the University of Guam, Guam CEDDERS, and GSAT leadership and advisory members for their commitment to providing and promoting accessibility and services to individuals with disabilities; and to commend them for their leadership and support in the 32nd Annual Guam System for Assistive Technology (GSAT) Fair. The presentation will take place on Saturday, June 27, 2026 at 1:30PM at the Micronesia Mall, Center Court. We look forward to your attendance and participation.…
